briefing.headline: OpenAI Orion-2 deployment triggers fresh safety concerns as global compute race intensifies

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate model releases amid regulatory pressure and compute shortages. US-China tensions dominate strategic AI deployments while investment surges past $11B this quarter.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships Orion-2 with 2.8T parameters; Anthropic counters with Claude 4 Opus; Google DeepMind unveils Gemini 3; Meta open-sources Llama 4; xAI releases Grok-3; DeepSeek launches V3. Multi-agent coordination benchmarks show rapid gains.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. Regulators push for mandatory red-teaming as DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent and automotive use cases.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp hits 1.2M units; Microsoft and Google announce new 200MW data center clusters in Texas and Arizona; TSMC 2nm yields improve for custom AI chips.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first company to reach 10^28 FLOP training run trigger an immediate international treaty response?
